scope: Minimum real Linux IIO to stock QVR DSP combined IMU input contract. Static reconstruction only; no device access or DSP calls occurred during this investigation.
conclusion: The existing external_sensor_lib path accepts a BOOTTIME/SI/Android-portrait 64-byte combined sample in ring 0, followed by no-buffer FastRPC method 10. It is compatible with start flags=0 for native source 1 outside SimpleViewer. Reproduce its AP transport directly in the Debian bridge; no Android HAL is needed for this input route.

stock_service_route.enabled_condition: A nonempty library path selects QVRServiceSensorsExternal in CreateModules, provided service source +0x1984==1. Empty selects native sensors if service+0xb8==0; otherwise remote SimpleViewer sensors.
stock_service_route.plugin_abi: dlopen(path) -> dlsym(getInstance) -> qvr_external_sensors_t {api_version=1,ops}; Init(); Start(DataReadyCb,HandleErrorCb,context); Stop() must cease callbacks.
stock_service_route.layout_selection: BasicInit sets RingBufferLayoutSetup(true) when external_sensor_lib is nonempty, even for source=1 and service+0xb8=0. Tracker::SetRingBufferLayout does not register raw_accel ring5 in this branch.
stock_service_route.debian_equivalent: Direct bridge may implement the proven ring writer and notification chain without loading an Android plugin. external_sensor_lib is an AP service selection, not an additional field in qvr_dsp_driver_start XML.
stock_service_route.source_gate: DataReadyCb accepts real callbacks only when service source +0x1984 is 1.

combined_ring.name: raw_gyro slot carrying combined external sensor data
combined_ring.descriptor_note: Only seven words are transmitted. Layout is eight 64-byte slots at offset0, then a 64-byte index area at offset512. type_tag/struct_id=2. These are the stock external row at service ELF0x136464, NOT the native direct-report record format.

index.meaning: Index of the most recently completed slot, not next-write cursor or sample count

record.meaning: latest cached real accel sample BOOTTIME ns
latest cached real accel xyz in m/s^2
stock external writer zeros these bytes; DSP combined consumer interprets the first 8 as optional magnetometer time and next12 as magnetometer vector; keep zero without a real magnetometer input
not written by the stock callback; initialize allocation/record to zero

producer_sequence: Cache each real accel timestamp and xyz; do not publish or notify for accel alone.
For each real gyro sample, finish one record with that gyro and cached latest accel. A Debian adapter should wait for its first real accel rather than inventing an initial measurement.
Complete all record writes and make them visible to the DSP according to DMA-buffer/cache semantics.
Publish the completed slot index in the first u32 of the index area; ensure index visibility follows record visibility.
Call method10 and wait for it to complete before publishing the next gyro slot.
combined_ring.consumer_behavior: Method10 consumes exactly the currently published slot, not all slots since the previous call. Do not publish a batch then notify once, and do not send a callback with no new real gyro.
combined_ring.cpu_cache_gate: The stock DSP invalidates its index and record cache lines before reading. The mainline bridge must use the actual mapped DMA-buffer coherency contract; where CPU mappings are cached, pair CPU access/cache synchronization and ordering before notify. This investigation did not measure AP-to-DSP cache visibility.

dsp_chain: Require valid mapped gyro ring0 and pose ring1.
Require mapped DL prediction ring29 and a pose destination.
Dispatch by DSP tracking mode: mode1 -> onSensorData_6Dof.
onSensorData_6Dof -> tracker_helper_6dof_imu_update -> TrackerWrapperIMUUpdate with gyro and accel records.
Publish pose and DL prediction outputs, then run forward prediction.
notification.success_limit: The exported notification returns0 after the consumer call and does not propagate tracking quality or every internal error. A successful RPC is not evidence of a valid 6DoF pose; inspect real output state/timestamps/quality.
notification.time_axis_unit_conversion: The param0 consumer copies the64B record and does not apply the SimpleViewer integer scaling/axis conversion or a QTimer offset. Supply required physical quantities and coordinates before publication.

start_compatibility.orientation: Stock still sets native sensor_orientation from trinity, but combined method10(param0) does not use that transform to repair producer axes. Input must already satisfy the external SDK frame.
start_compatibility.other_rings: Retain ring1 pose, ring29 DL prediction, ring8 predicted pose, ring7 health, and the other stock tracker setup described in start-contract.json.
start_compatibility.flags_1_is_different: SimpleViewer flag1 drives QDI receiver -> combined consumer(param1), which decodes/scales a different128-byte raw input area. Do not enable it for this64-byte external plugin path.
start_compatibility.flags_4_is_different: Stock canned-source flag4 suppresses native QDI processing. It is not required by the proven external plugin source1 path.
start_compatibility.native_callback_separation: Do not also register/start the native Android direct channels while using combined ring0; the native receiver interprets another memory format.

clock_contract.imu: Use CLOCK_BOOTTIME ns for both gyro and accel, preserving separate real sample timestamps.
clock_contract.camera: External-plugin equivalent path leaves camera capture timestamps in BOOTTIME as well. VRTrackerF adds AndroidToQTimeDiff only when external_sensor_lib is empty and service+0xb8==0.
clock_contract.no_receive_timestamp_substitution: Read the actual timestamp in the IIO scan record; do not replace it with poll/read completion time.
clock_contract.existing_reader_difference: Current open_stream explicitly requests current_timestamp_clock=monotonic. A direct reuse must request/read back boottime on both exclusive streams, with buffers disabled during clock changes, and confirm the selected driver timestamps honor that clock.
clock_contract.qtimer_rpc: qvr_dsp_driver_get_current_qtimer method9 returns qurt_sysclock_get_hw_ticks directly. It is raw hardware ticks, not ns. This external path does not need that value.
clock_contract.suspend: Do not assume monotonic==boottime after suspend. Prefer a driver-supplied boottime scan timestamp over an unverified offset conversion.

minimal_real_iio_adapter.shape_gate: Re-read scan_elements indices and types; existing adapter expects xyz le:s32/32>>0 and timestamp le:s64/64>>0. This is a current source expectation, not a new on-device observation.
minimal_real_iio_adapter.units: Multiply each raw xyz component by the exposed in_accel_scale or in_anglvel_scale exactly once. Record both scale values. Do not substitute synthetic IMU data.
minimal_real_iio_adapter.axes: Confirm existing SEE/IIO output-to-Android-portrait orientation before start; apply any required measured transform in the AP adapter, once. The identity trinity transform alone does not prove Linux IIO equivalence.
minimal_real_iio_adapter.calibration: Pass the stock device_calibration.xml to the stock tracker; do not duplicate its bias/extrinsic processing in the transport adapter.
minimal_real_iio_adapter.ownership: Acquire exclusive real sensor buffers, preserve changed attributes and restore after stop. Configure BOOTTIME before enabling buffers. No device operations were performed by this task.
minimal_real_iio_adapter.acceptance: Actual samples with increasing BOOTTIME times -> visible DMA record/index -> successful notify -> changing stock pose timestamps plus valid tracking state. Positional tracking additionally requires real calibrated camera input.

native_see_assessment.established_path: Stock QVRServiceSensorsNative::Init gets gyro ring0 and accel ring5, registers two SharedMemInfo direct channels through Android HIDL sensors service; ConfigDirectReportStart calls the HAL direct-report entry with rate level3. DSP then consumes those buffers on QuRT /dev/vr callback.
native_see_assessment.dsp_receiver: ELF0xc060 waits using qurt_qdi_qhi3(0,handle,0x102); start flags0 selects native direct-report processing, flag1 selects128B remote input, flag4 skips this processing.
native_see_assessment.qdi_initialization: DSP constructor ELF0x7434 opens QuRT /dev/vr via qurt_qdi_qhi4(0,4,2,"/dev/vr"), initializes with method0x100, allocates16KiB thread stack, and creates adsp_imu/sensor_data_ready_interrupt_receiver. This initialization occurs even when the AP intends to use method10.
native_see_assessment.device_namespace: /dev/vr here is a DSP QuRT QDI endpoint. This is not evidence that a Linux /dev/vr node should be created.
native_see_assessment.conclusion: No observed QVR call in this recovery directly subscribes to SEE/QMI from CDSP and independently starts sensor acquisition. Existing native route depends on Android HAL/direct channels and a firmware notification path. Reusing real Debian IIO via the explicit external64B method10 route is the supported contract recovered here.
native_see_assessment.scope_limit: This is not a claim that every firmware component lacks a SEE API; no whole-firmware audit was performed.

remaining_gates: Root must resolve real CDSP module initialization and mapping first.
Prove mainline DMA cache visibility for the mapped buffer.
Confirm real IIO axes and BOOTTIME timestamps; no sensor sample was read in this investigation.
Start with real four-camera data for positional tracking; successful IMU-only notification cannot establish6DoF.
evidence_notes: For these REA imports, Ghidra addresses equal ELF virtual addresses +0x10000.
Small QVR DSP library only; the large tracker binary was not reopened.
Hexagon pseudocode has inferred signatures and removed-block warnings. Key conclusions are supported by AP producer, DSP consumer, explicit debug assertions and shipped SDK ABI together.
The zero initialization, first-real-accel gate and synchronous per-gyro adapter prescription are implementation choices preserving real input; distinguish them from exact stock callback behavior.
